free.name: Galaxy Free
perks: 1 plot to build on (claim it with your Plot Claiming Shovel)
1 shop plot in the Shop District (sell to other players with shop chests)
Proximity voice chat and community chat on galaxymc.us

plus.name: Galaxy+
perks: [GALAXY+] tag with a star icon, in chat, shown in an aurora gradient (green to purple) above your head
Build up to 2 elevators in your plots (/elevator)

pro.name: Galaxy Pro+
perks: [PRO+] tag with a winged diamond in chat, shown in a royal gradient (pink to blue) above your head
Build up to 4 elevators in your plots (/elevator)
Sparkle and Galaxy particle trails + a firework when you join (/cosmetics)
